column3: ELIAS: Yes, I couldn't describe the League as anything but a success if it attracted such an effective Champion.
AME: Well, that's a huge relief, given that I've never once known what I'm doing here.
Even just acting as the Champion myself was only meant to be temporary until we finally did have a winner.
But I shouldn't have been so worried.
After all, I had all of your help!
A member of the Elite Four from the old League also taking that role in this newer one...
I don't think I could have done it without you, Elias.
Your willingness to help me organize this League and figure out how to run this...
Whatever great success this League has in your time, you should know that you are just as, if not more responsible than I am.
Thank you, Elias.
ELIAS: I...
Responsible for what happens with the League, you say?
I think you're right...
AME: But here I go, talking your ear off!
I'm sure you both have very important business to attend to back home.
Shimmer and I have very important official legal League business that requires us to stay in this room, too.
So don't let me keep you!
Be sure to say "Hi" to me back in your time!
???: Come on... Just a little closer...
TAKA: Wait, that sounds like...
Uh, I don't think we're quite in the present yet, \PN.
ELIAS: That... is not Anna's voice.
...I see.
Shimmer is politely watching you, but you can tell she's eager to get back to the rescue mission.
TAKA: Agent Borealis...
That's what we called Corey.
Elena seemed so sure he'd do great things.
She made him sound so happy. Full of life.
The Borealis I knew was so... empty.
I guess after he lost her...
TAKA: I guess this is another Elite Four room?
This one is kind of creepy.
ELIAS: Ah, we're still in the past.
Because this room belongs to...
Huh.
I had completely forgotten about Anna until we got here.
In our time, she is unavailable, so her chamber has already been decommissioned.
In our time, Anna is unavailable, so her chamber has already been decommissioned.
So this is clearly the recent past, but still the past nonetheless.
ELIAS: You know, I always found this room rather unsettling.
Although she is a rather unsettling child, so perhaps that is fitting.
Despite that, I suppose she has her own sort of wisdom.
Not to mention a Legendary Pokémon of her own.
Perhaps this is exactly what Celebi needs.
Yes
No
LIN: So one makes it after all.
Through mountain and molehill,
You persevere as predictably as ever.
Now that you're here, we've no need for words,
Do we?
The others have kept you long enough.
What needed to be finished, has been.
The final PULSE machine...
That which will open the way to the new world.
You may see for yourself, or fail trying.
LIN: Do not relish in your victory too soon.
You are not afforded the privilege of the usual success.
This creature was created not to fight, but to obey.
LIN: Abra.
Take us there.
FLORA: Finally...
This has only been a gigantic pain in my ass.
Look, this is going to take a while.
I'm confident this is all I need, so you can go.
First, I'm getting my data, and second, I'm releasing this poor Abra ASAP.
I can't believe it was just hooked up to this thing and left here...
Whoever did this must've been beyond rotten.
And if it's in the Champion room...
I suppose you already dealt with them, huh.
Well, you get some points from me for that.
Anyway, this won't be quick.
You can go do... whatever it is Champions do in these places.
There's a room further back, isn't there?
I'll meet you at Eve's house later once I'm done.
FLORA: This won't be quick.
WELCOME TO THE REBORN LEAGUE HALL OF FAME
Registering .
Registering . .
Registering . . .
TAKA: So, this is the Champion chamber then, huh?
It's pretty dull compared to the Elite Four rooms, don't you think?
???: I couldn't agree more!
ELENA?: Taka, \PN.
It's great to see you both again.
TAKA: Wait, Elena!?
Celebi, did you take us backwards again?
I thought we were finally back home...
NOT ELENA: Elena?
Oh, duh.
Luck would certainly lead you to her on a journey through time.
I never met her myself but...
I hope she was nice.
Dad never really spoke about her...
TAKA: Dad...
Wait, Heather?
You look just like her--
I'm sorry, I--
HEATHER: No, don't apologize.
It's...
I'm just glad you both finally showed up.
You both just disappeared one day.
Until she figured out it was Celebi, nobody had any idea where you went.
Everyone was pretty bummed out.
TAKA: I'm not surprised, with \PN vanishing.
HEATHER: With BOTH of you vanishing.
People were just as sad that you were gone too, Taka.
TAKA: That's...
Wait, you mentioned 'she'?
Who are you talking about?
HEATHER: Heh.
The Champion, of course!
You don't think we'd just go ten years without someone claiming the title, do you?
She was the one that figured out you found Celebi and were traveling through time.
A lot of people lost faith but...
She was certain you'd both come back.
Not that she didn't stack the deck in our favor.
She knew Celebi would come looking for the Relic Stone, so she went to the New World and got it back herself.
That way, Celebi would hopefully bring you to us.
And here we are...
TAKA: So... I mean, who is it?
Who's the Champion now?
HEATHER: ...You'll see.
First time in Reborn's history that a Gym Leader has challenged the Pokémon League--
And won on her first try, no less!
But I shouldn't keep you, she's waiting.
She wanted a fancy room like we Elite Four get, so we just turned this into an entranceway.
Seriously, for a champion room, this was so underwhelming.
Anyway, head through the door in back to get to her room.
And... I'll see you guys later.
Or, I guess, earlier?
Time travel is confusing.
TAKA: Ten years in the future...
Do you think she meant it?
That people were sad that...
That people noticed I was gone?
...Come on, Celebi.
Let's go meet the Champion, I guess.
ELIAS: Back at last, it seems.
I must say, though, such a simple chamber is not befitting of you, my Lord.
As Champion, I feel you should have a room at least as impressive as the Elite Four.
ELENA?: El, \PN.
It's been a while.
ELIAS: Oh dear, did we go back in time again for some reason?
Wait, you look a little different...
NOT ELENA: No shit, old man.
I'm not a kid anymore.
You've been gone 10 years.
ELIAS: That doesn't--
Heather, hello.
My apologies, I thought you were--
I'm sorry, did you just say 10 years?
HEATHER: Yeah, we were the Elite Three with no Champion for a bit.
But the League is totally different now, except for me.
But anyway, you probably both have a lot on your minds, so you should probably talk to the Champion.
ELIAS: You replaced \PN?
But they weren't even here to--
HEATHER: You should be grateful.
She's the one that figured out where you both went.
Before she worked out you had traveled through time, we all thought you both just... vanished.
But here you both are, back like she said you would be, eventually.
Although, she was probably so sure because she went and got the Relic Stone herself, to attract Celebi here.
This is just an entranceway now; we made a whole room for her, just like the Elite Four get.
ELIAS: She sounds very impressive.
ELIAS: So who is it?
And won on her first try, no less.
But I shouldn't keep you.
She's waiting.
Just head through the door in back to get to her room.
And... I'll see you two later.
HEATHER: And... welcome back, \PN.
We all really missed you.
ELIAS: ...She looks almost exactly like her mother.
ELIAS: Well, we shouldn't keep this mysterious new Champion waiting.
An unknown challenger is approaching!

Singles

Absolute power corrupts absolutely.
Any man who thinks himself exempt to this is his own example to its truth.
At heart, all are dark.

LIN: Make no mistake,
I know what I am.
I know what we are.
We are the mother who murders her child.
This world is broken.
The world is crying.
The world is us.
It's time to sing us to sleep.
Light
LIN: Welcome,
To the death of the old world,
And the birth of a new one.
This is a place I know all too well,
Though it did not look like this before I arrived.
Here, in this sacred womb...
I will be the abortion.
Absolute corruption must always be answered, must it not?
Then answer me, once, finally, and for all!
Arceus!
LIN: Imprisoned here for eons forgotten...
Your long wait is finally over, child.
With the power imbued in this tainted stone, I grant you the fate you never once deserved!
LIN: And so, down to the very core of your being,
You are mine.
Now, and for forever.
Understand now,
Majesty...
Magnificence...
Power...
I have them all.
You've done well so far.
But now...
It's time for it all to end.
LIN: Others have come.
I brushed them aside.
I felt nothing.
Not pity.
Not remorse.
Not pride.
All I've ever had was the power to hinder dreams.
That's all anyone has ever had.
This is no life for me to live,
But I have lost,
And I am lost.
So go.
Savor it.
Claim your prize.
And I will remain the shell of the person I once was to suffer ever on.
